purpose: Teach: レーン/バラード/アサ/ファイア/台場/ハロ/冴え/エッジ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さん、本気で、絶対、ボーリングのレーンで、絶対、上手なんだよ、ぼく、本気で、誇り、絶対、本気で、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Mom, Dad is seriously so good at bowling. I'm really proud of him. Really, I mean it.
lines.style: Urgent, breathless energy. Words tumbling out fast. Opens big on 'Mom' to grab attention. Earnest emphasis on 'good' and 'proud' — this matters. No irony, pure admiration.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お父さん、本気で、絶対、バラードの曲、絶対、好きなのよ、翔くん、本気で、絶対、よく、口ずさんでるわよ、本気、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Mm-hmm. Your dad really does love ballad songs, Sho. You know how he hums them all the time.
lines.style: Warm, knowing smile in the voice. Gentle confirmation — she's been listening to the same humming. Soft, unhurried pace. Speaking as if to share a small, comfortable secret with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんち、本気で、絶対、アサが、絶対、咲いていたよ、ママ、覚えてる?本気で、絶対、綺麗、本気で、本気、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: At Grandpa's place — do you remember the morning glories that were blooming? They were so beautiful, Mom.
lines.style: Bright recall, eyes lighting up in the voice. Slight upswing at 'remember?' — checking if she was there too. Pace picks up at 'beautiful,' holding it with wonder. Small child certainty.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 夏祭り、本気で、絶対、ファイアショー、絶対、家族で、楽しんだわよね、翔くん、覚えてる?本気で、絶対、感動、本気で、絶対、本気、本気で。
lines.en: That summer festival with the fireworks — we all enjoyed it so much together, didn't we, Sho? I was really moved.
lines.style: Soft, reflective. Eyes distant with the memory. Slower pace. 'Didn't we' leans gently on him for confirmation. Warmth underneath — the kind of tenderness that comes from holding something precious.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 家族で、本気で、絶対、お台場、絶対、行きたいよね、ママ、夏休みに、行こうよ、絶対、本気で、本気、絶対、お願い、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: We should all go to Odaiba together during summer break, shouldn't we, Mom? Please can we go?
lines.style: Excited pitch rises on 'Odaiba.' Quick, hopeful pace. 'Please' softens with a small-child directness — not whining, just asking with his whole heart. Leans forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今年、本気で、絶対、ハロウィン、絶対、家族で、楽しもうね、翔くん、お母さん、本気で、絶対、衣装、用意してるわよ、本気で、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Let's all have fun with Halloween this year, Sho. I'm already getting your costumes ready, you know.
lines.style: Bright, planning-tone energy. Gentle pride on 'already getting ready' — she's been thinking ahead. Warm, inclusive 'let's.' Pace steady and reassuring, like a promise she's keeping.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、頭が、冴え冴えとした、人だよね、ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、尊敬してる
lines.en: Your dad really does have a sharp mind, doesn't he, Mom? I really respect him.
lines.style: Thoughtful, sincere. Opens softer than the first line. Pause after 'sharp mind' — he's choosing his words carefully. 'I really respect him' lands with quiet conviction, no performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、エッジの効いた、本気で、絶対、デザイン、お洒落、好きだよね、翔くん、ね
lines.en: Your dad does like edgy, stylish design, doesn't he, Sho? That's very him.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost to herself. Gentle rise on 'doesn't he' — she's inviting Sho to agree. Trailing-off on 'that's very him' — a small, knowing smile. Reflective, like she's seeing him clearly.
